ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominance of high-intensity white (approximately 65%) against low-intensity black (approximately 35%) primarily localized in the central and inner regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large, irregular dark pigmentation zone emanating from the center, transitioning into feathered/mottled patterns. Black pigmentation also follows the trailing edge of the left lobe and forms discrete clusters on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped depression with an estimated interior angle of 115 degrees; the vertex is partially obscured by water turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, low-frequency serrations across the trailing edge; right lobe exhibits approximately 6 distinct peaks, while the left lobe shows more jagged, higher-frequency irregularities.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge trajectory with significant upward distal sweep towards the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-relief clusters of dark-to-white pixel transitions at both fluke tips, indicating heavy barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple thin, dark, parallel linear disruptions visible on the mid-section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue buildup and pigmentation loss at the distal tips due to heavy barnacle encrustation; jagged irregularities on the trailing edge suggest minor historical tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive 'fringed' or 'shredded' pixel boundaries at the interface where the central black pigmentation meets the white ventral fields.
